docs.text: ChemXAI Documentation Library for Explainable AI in Chemical Machine Learning Overview ChemXAI provides explainable AI tools for chemical machine learning with support for tabular molecular descriptors and graph neural networks. Features Data Module QM9 Dataset PCQM4Mv2 Dataset Morgan fingerprints RDKit 2D 3D descriptors Coulomb matrices Models Module MLP Multi-layer perceptron GCN Graph convolutional network Explainers Module Tabular SHAP LIME Graph GNNExplain GraphShap GraphLIME NodeGraphShap NodeGrapLIME Evaluation Module RobustnessEvaluator MolecularAnalyzer TabularAnalyzer GraphAnalyzer Plots Module radar_plot horizontal_bar_plot k_hop_subgraph Installation pip install chemxai Quick Start from chemxai.data import qm9_tabular from chemxai.models import MLP from chemxai.explainers import Shap qm9 = qm9_tabular() loaders = qm9.get_paired_dataloaders_tabular(batch_size=32, descriptor_type='Morgan') model = MLP(input_size=512, hidden_sizes=[256, 128], output_size=1) explainer = Shap(model=model, background_tensor=bg_data, test_tensor=test_data, device=device) explanation = explainer.explain_local(index=0)

docs.text: Evaluation Module RobustnessEvaluator Compare explanations from clean vs noisy models Metrics cosine similarity L1 distance L2 distance Spearman correlation MolecularAnalyzer Fingerprint analysis Fragment visualization Bit importance TabularAnalyzer Fidelity metrics Feature masking GraphAnalyzer Groundtruth metrics Fidelity Unfaithfulness Example Robustness from chemxai.evaluate import RobustnessEvaluator evaluator = RobustnessEvaluator(model_normal=model1, model_noise=model2, train_loader_normal=train_clean, test_loader_normal=test_clean, train_loader_noise=train_noisy, test_loader_noise=test_noisy, device=device, explainer_type='shap_local') similarities, l1, l2, spearman, figs = evaluator.robustness() Example Molecular from chemxai.evaluate import MolecularAnalyzer analyzer = MolecularAnalyzer(explanation=shap_vals, batch_idx=0, mol_idx=0, dataset_type='test') summary = analyzer.analyze()
